meta.name: workflow-patterns
meta.description: Use this skill when implementing tasks according to Conductor's TDD workflow, handling phase checkpoints, managing git commits for tasks, or understanding the verification protocol.

copy.tagline: 遵循测试驱动开发流程分阶段完成开发任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要按测试驱动方式规范地完成开发任务
copy.tagline_en: Follow a test-driven development workflow to complete development tasks in phases.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to follow a strict test-driven workflow in your development tasks.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 Conductor 的 TDD 工作流实施任务：先写失败测试，再实现使其通过；在阶段检查点暂停等待批准；按小步提交 git 并附上下文说明；任务完成后更新 plan.md。
howto.when: 当按 Conductor 的 TDD 工作流实施任务、处理阶段检查点或 git 提交时触发。

say.text: 先为这个功能写失败测试，再开始实现。
say.note: 让 Claude 遵循 TDD 的 RED 步骤。

say.text: 按小步提交这次改动，提交信息写上背景说明。
say.note: Claude 会执行一次带上下文的 git 提交。

say.text: 到达阶段检查点了，请核对质量门禁并更新 plan.md。
say.note: Claude 会暂停并执行检查点验证。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will implement tasks using Conductor's TDD workflow: write failing tests first, then make them pass; pause at phase checkpoints for approval; make small git commits with context; and update plan.md after completion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when implementing tasks from a plan.md, following the TDD red-green-refactor cycle, or at phase checkpoints.

say_en.text: Write a failing test for this feature before implementing it.
say_en.note: Claude follows the RED step of TDD.

say_en.text: Commit this change as a small logical unit with context in the message.
say_en.note: Claude makes a git commit with context.

say_en.text: We reached a phase checkpoint. Verify quality gates and update plan.md.
say_en.note: Claude pauses and performs checkpoint verification.
